name: Slider
summary: Lets people pick a value in a range by moving a thumb along a track.
description: A slider sets a value whose position in a range matters more than its exact figure: a volume, a brightness, a price ceiling. A thumb slides along a track between a minimum and a maximum, by steps; the value can be shown next to the label. When the exact number matters, a Number field is better, alone or next to the slider.

anatomy.description: Root. Stacks the label row (label and value) and the control; carries the size and the forced state.
Text naming the quantity. Provides the accessible name of the slider.
The current value shown at the end of the label row (an output bound to the control on the web).
The track: the native range input, drawn by the component. Receives focus, holds the value and its bounds; the thumb slides along it.
The knob people drag or move with the keyboard. Drawn by the control (vendor pseudo-elements on the web): it has tokens but no element of its own.

properties.name: Size
properties.description: Thickness of the track and size of the thumb.

options.description: Compact: inline in panels and toolbars (4 px track, 16 px thumb).

properties.name: Label
properties.description: The quantity being set (Volume, Maximum price).

properties.name: Step
properties.description: Increment of a key press and granularity of the values.

properties.name: Show value
properties.description: Shows the current value at the end of the label row.

properties.name: Disabled
properties.description: Prevents changing the value; the current value stays visible.

states.description: Resting: a neutral track with the brand thumb at the value's position.
Pointer over the control. The thumb takes the brand hover color. Needs a pointing device: touch has no hover.
The thumb is being dragged, or a key is held: it takes the brand press color.
Keyboard focus on the control. Shows the shared focus ring around the whole track; pointer focus shows none.
Non-interactive. Track, thumb, label and value drop to the shared disabled colors.

notes: The label row comes first: the label at the start, the value at the end; the track fills the width below it.
The control is 24 px high whatever the track thickness, so the pointer target is kept; the thumb is centered on the track.

name.text: Computed from the label, associated with the control as its label element on the web. The value, the minimum and the maximum are exposed as the slider's value and bounds; when the number is not meaningful by itself (a day of the week), the application adds a text value through the template's extra attributes.

keyboard.action: Moves focus to the control. A disabled slider is not focusable and is skipped.
Right or Up increases the value by one step, Left or Down decreases it.
Sets the value to the minimum.
Sets the value to the maximum.

guidelines.text: Expose the slider role, the name, the value and its bounds through the platform's native slider, so assistive technology reports the value as a number and lets people change it.
Use the native input type=range: it exposes the slider role, the value, min and max without ARIA, and provides the arrow keys, Home and End. Do not add aria-valuemin or aria-valuemax to it.
Every slider has a visible label associated with the control programmatically; show the value when the figure helps people choose.
The shown value is an output element bound to the control; without script it shows the initial value, and the application updates it as the value changes.
When the number alone is not meaningful (Monday rather than 1), give the control a text value with aria-valuetext.

Dragging the thumb is never the only pointer way: people can activate a point of the track to move the thumb there, and the keyboard changes the value by steps (the keyboard alone does not satisfy the dragging criterion).

The thumb and the track are what identify the control and show its value: the thumb contrasts at least 3:1 with the track and the surface in every color mode (brand fill 4.85:1 on the track in light mode and 10.73:1 in dark mode, 5.79:1 and 12.80:1 on the default surface; its light rim separates it from the track), and the focus ring 5.79:1 and 12.80:1. Disabled is exempt.
Label and value text contrast at least 4.5:1 with the surface: 19.07:1 and 12.87:1 (light), 11.27:1 and 8.80:1 (dark) on the default surface. Disabled text is inactive and exempt.
The value is shown by the position of the thumb and, when asked for, by the figure in text, never by color alone.
A visible focus indicator appears when the control receives keyboard focus, drawn around the whole track so it is seen whatever the thumb position.
The focus ring is drawn with :focus-visible, so pointer focus shows no ring; the thumb is styled through the vendor pseudo-elements, one rule per vendor.
The control is 24 CSS pixels high at every size, so the whole track is a pointer target at the minimum, whatever the track thickness.
The native disabled attribute removes the slider from the focus order.

A slider is a horizontal track with a thumb that people adjust between a minimum and a maximum value: consider a label to introduce it and live feedback as the value changes. The 24 pt control falls under the 44 x 44 pt hit region on iOS today.

Android recommends a touch target of at least 48 x 48 dp; Material's Slider sets that minimum itself when it can receive actions. A custom slider exposes its value, range and step with the progress range semantics.
Color transitions of the thumb are removed when the user asks for reduced motion.

guidelines: The label names the quantity, with its unit when the value is shown: Volume, Maximum price (€).
Show the value when the figure helps; hide it when the position says enough (a volume).
Choose a step people can reason about: 1, 5, 10, 0.5.

decisions.text: The track is the third neutral base fill (as the Progress bar's) and the thumb the accent brand fill, going to its hover and press steps, with a rim in the default surface color; disabled takes the shared disabled colors. The track has no filled portion before the thumb.
decisions.rationale: The Figma library maps no color to sliders; the brand thumb keeps 3:1 against the track in both modes. A filled portion is not available in every browser without script.

decisions.text: Two sizes from the space scale: small (4 px track, 16 px thumb) and medium (8 px track, 20 px thumb, the default); the control is 24 px high at both, the thumb has a 1.2 px rim.

The slider is the native range input: one thumb, horizontal; the keyboard, the track activation and the value exposure are the browser's. Two thumbs (a range of values), vertical sliders and tick marks are not specified.

changelog.note: Initial draft (decisions track-and-thumb-colors, sizes, native-range). Native range input named by a label element, with an optional output value; states default, hover, active, focus-visible, disabled; sizes small and medium. Contrast, light / dark: thumb on track 4.85 / 10.73, thumb on the default surface 5.79 / 12.80, label 19.07 / 11.27, value 12.87 / 8.80, focus ring 5.79 / 12.80.
